purpose: Re-capture the same no-input ADSP SOM transaction with live register snapshots around the producer and interpolation helpers.

same_window_post_gint.correlation_to_this_146-word_block: not established; counts include later frame traffic

adsp_program_snapshot.path: tools/mame-adsp-program-dump at frames 551 and 600 (local captures /tmp/opencode/adsp-prog551 and /tmp/opencode/adsp-prog600)
adsp_program_snapshot.interpretation: 24-bit PM values in 32-bit MAME containers; low branch reads MY0 from bits 23:8 at base 0x1036 plus selector. These PM cells match at frames 551 and 600 and the transaction's MY0 register snapshots confirm them. The full PM images differ by 2748 bytes, so whole-image stability is not claimed.

limitations: This is one transaction on the 600-frame input=none path, not a full gameplay trace.
The captured output is SOMLATCH traffic; it does not prove the semantic meaning of every emitted word.
The post-GINT SOM-buffer/HSTDAT counts include later frame traffic and are not attributed one-to-one to this block.
The C implementation in this slice is only the signed-by-unsigned ADSP multiply kernel; it is not the ADSP producer routine or a geometry pipeline.

register_capture.same_as_base_capture: SOM word vector identical; ADSP producer-event stream identical when removing register snapshot fields.

derived_record_layout.note: Interpretation of the raw producer_events stream, not raw evidence. Every SOMLATCH word in this capture is attributed to the ADSP program counter that latched it.

transaction_envelope.0x0034: SOMCLK DM($2003) = $0000, resets the SOM word pointer

record_layout_words.source: five words: DM($003E), DM($003F), DM($003C), DM($003D), run length

derived_record_layout.span_run_length_rule: min(AY0,AY1) - AX1 + 1, verified against all 18 captured spans

guard_levels.prologue: $0574/$0577 use IF LE; AY0 and AY1 must be strictly greater than AX1
guard_levels.loop_tails: $0594/$059A/$05B4/$05CE use IF LT; equality is legal, and record 2's second span has AY0 == AY1 == AX1 with run length 1
guard_levels.asymmetry: only $059A re-checks AY0; the $0595 and $05CF tails return to $0579 without it

derived_record_layout.limitation: All nine records latch DM(I1,M1) and DM(I2,M2) to equal values, so start_x and delta_x cannot be distinguished by value from this capture; only the per-word program-counter attribution pins their order.
